name: Do I need a building permit to add an ADU to my property?
description: Yes, building an ADU requires structural, electrical, and plumbing permits along with official municipal inspections to meet residential safety codes.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit to add an ADU to my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, building an accessory dwelling unit requires building, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical permits approved by your local municipal building department. Because an ADU is classified as habitable space with running water, cooking facilities, and dedicated power, unpermitted construction violates local building codes. Building plans must comply with residential safety standards, including structural load requirements, minimum ceiling heights, fire separation, and emergency egress windows in bedrooms. Work must pass formal stage-by-stage building inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, building an ADU requires structural, electrical, and plumbing permits along with official municipal inspections to meet residential safety codes.
